explication: TensorRT Edge-LLM is an NVIDIA edge inference framework for text, vision, audio, speech, and action models. A typical path takes a model checkpoint through export or direct engine building, then deploys the resulting artifacts in the shared C++ runtime; requests are scheduled, preprocessed and decoded, with generated tokens streamed back to a caller. The graph also preserves multimodal handling, cache reuse, speculative decoding, multi-device execution, and the experimental Python server. Several runtime links are based on the README or source-index references; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
